title: Execute the complete balanced CRT address-state endpoint from encoded source with a paid 79-role commit lifecycle (no new kappa)
body:
## Result
Join the encoded forward balanced CRT node iterator to whole-node result projection and retire-before-commit source writing. Preserve current coordinates and metadata through changes in width and precision.

## Novelty and predecessors
#7154 provides the read-only iterator, #7152 compiled geometry and #5053 numerical nodes; this supplies their changing-source consumer boundary on 79 stable roles with O(A^4) source-model time and O(A^2) extra historical backing.

## Verification
Independent node/source oracle and author replay. Run python3 -I -W error -B research/encoded-balanced-crt-endpoint/verify.py.

## Limits and kappa
Source-level address-state result, not payload routing, raw S^-1 or literal binary refinement. No new kappa; 0.00363005817 remains conditional.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors and PRs as detailed in the package.

Full proof, reproducibility, negative controls and provenance: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/d2ed3959c30528b0b85fc6d815d4ad4f94f6be86/research/encoded-balanced-crt-endpoint
